newsitem.title: ITALY: Fiat opens 2.9 pct off on 1996 results.
newsitem.headline: Fiat opens 2.9 pct off on 1996 results.

text.p: Shares in Fiat SpA opened 2.91 percent lower at 5,000 lire on a weaker Milan stock exchange on 1996 group results announced on Thursday night.
Fiat said its 1996 operating profit fell sharply to around 1.8 trillion lire after 1995's 3.325 trillion lire, while sales rose three percent to around 78 trillion lire.

In the group's traditional letter to shareholders, Fiat reported that 1996 pre-tax profit would rise slightly to around 3.5 trillion lire from 1995's 3.404 trillion lire, while its operating margin across the whole group slipped to 2.3 percent from 4.4 percent in 1995.

"The results were below analysts' expectations but higher Italian orders in January helped by the government's new-cars-for-old incentive scheme has compensated somewhat for the disappointment," one broker said.
The all-share Mibtel index was 0.17 percent down.
